answer: Sybil resistance can be built through a stake-weighted thread of attestations: each agent must lock tokens and gather signatures from distinct, previously verified peers before acting. A zephyr of cheap throwaway identities fails because forging every peer link costs real stake, while a falcon-like auditor randomly samples one attestation chain per epoch and slashes duplicates. Attackers must fund many independent identities plus collateral, making mass forgery economically irrational. The sa0038 deployment anchors trust at UcQyLseZw9.
